problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to reduce impact of stolen credentials
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and simulated phishing exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing emails crafted using personal information to deceive specific individuals into revealing sensitive data or executing malicious actions.
risk_reduction: Educate employees on recognizing spear phishing tactics
Use email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Limit publicly available personal information on social media

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive information from employees.
risk_reduction: Verify financial requests through secondary communication channels
Implement strict email authentication and monitoring
Train staff to recognize and report suspicious email requests

problems.description: Use of AI to craft highly convincing and personalized phishing messages at scale, increasing success rates.
risk_reduction: Deploy AI-based detection tools for phishing emails
Enhance user awareness training with examples of AI-generated content
Implement strong email authentication and anomaly detection

problems.description: Publicly exposed cloud storage buckets leading to data leakage or unauthorized access.
risk_reduction: Implement strict access controls and encryption for cloud storage
Use automated tools to scan for misconfigurations
Enforce least privilege policies and continuous monitoring

problems.description: Attackers compromise software dependencies or update mechanisms to inject malicious code into widely distributed software.
risk_reduction: Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) and dependency scanning
Use code signing and verify update integrity
Establish vendor risk management and continuous monitoring

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data or model parameters to degrade or subvert machine learning model performance.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training datasets
Use robust training algorithms resistant to poisoning
Monitor model behavior for anomalies

problems.description: Attackers exfiltrate sensitive data before encrypting systems, threatening to release data publicly if ransom is not paid.
risk_reduction: Implement robust data backup and recovery plans
Deploy network segmentation and endpoint detection
Conduct regular threat hunting and incident response drills
